newsitem.title: USA: Amway Japan, Rubbermaid in co-branding pact.
newsitem.headline: Amway Japan, Rubbermaid in co-branding pact.

text.p: Amway Japan Ltd and Rubbermaid Inc said Friday they had struck a deal under which they will develop and produce an exclusive co-branded line of Rubbermaid products to be distributed by Amway Japan.
The companies said they plan to launch a food storage container line this spring that targets the particular needs and tastes of the Japanese market and uses Amway Japan's distribution force.
They did not disclose further details of the pact.

"With the reach and market savvy of Amway, the alliance has outstanding global potential for mutual benefit and is yet another way in which Rubbermaid intends to place its brands in the hands of new consumers worldwide," said Wolfgang Schmitt, Rubbermaid's chairman and chief executive.

Amway Japan is the exclusive distribution vehicle in Japan for Amway Corp. Rubbermaid, based in Wooster, Ohio, makes consumer and household products as well as Little Tikes toys and Graco infant furnishings.
